note: Level flapping flight. `airborne` is what makes this not a gait: no foot is load-bearing, so the legs ride with the body instead of staying pinned to a world point, and legHold lets them hang under the belly, a little bent and trailing, with the feet pitched so the claws point down -- which is also the shape of a foot holding something, and the kill hangs from them (render/dragons.js talons). The wings beat once per cycle about the body's forward axis; the twist that pitches the leading edge leads the beat by a quarter cycle, which is where a real wing's thrust comes from, and bobPhase puts the body's rise on the downstroke rather than on the default footfall beat. Crouch is negative, which is how an in-place clip gets off the ground: it is the one term that moves the body without a footfall behind it.
